log.text: Light Screen up on P1's side
Tsareena used High Jump Kick → Grimmsnarl

decisions.rationale: Lead Mega Gengar+Grimmsnarl: Shadow Tag pressure + Light Clay Fake Out/screens blunt Whimsicott/Delphox/Metagross openers and cut SpA. Back Altaria Cloud Nine kills rain/Swift Swim Basc and Tailwind; Annihilape Rage Fist/CC vs Mega Delphox/Metagross. Bench Prim/Avalugg.
decisions.notebook: Opp: rain Politoed Drizzle+Shed Shell; Basculegion Swift Swim Mystic Water Jolly WaveCrash/LastRespects/AquaJet; Mega Delphox Timid; Metagross LO Adamant; Whimsicott MentalHerb Prankster Timid Tailwind/Encore/LS/Moonblast; Tsareena WideLens Queenly Adamant. Our core: Cloud Nine Altaria shuts weather; Mega Gengar Shadow Tag deletes Psychic/Steel/Fairy; Grimmsnarl LC screens+FO+SpiritBreak; Annihilape Defiant RF; Prim LO Liquid Voice; Avalugg Sturdy WG/Body Press. Lead Gengar+Grimm; back Alt+Ape. Priority: tag Delphox/Metagross, deny Tailwind/rain.

decisions.rationale: Lead Whimsicott + Delphox for immediate speed control and Mega Delphox pressure into Gengar and Annihilape. Metagross provides a durable Fairy matchup and removes screens with Psychic Fangs; Tsareena pressures Primarina and Avalugg while blocking priority. This avoids relying on rain into Primarina.
decisions.notebook: Primary non-rain mode: Whimsicott/Mega Delphox with Metagross and Tsareena. Mega Delphox's exact stats are 152 HP / 80 Atk / 92 Def / 211 SpA / 145 SpD / 204 Spe, so it naturally exceeds Mega Gengar's revealed maximum raw Speed of 200. Preserve Delphox to threaten Gengar and Annihilape; consider Protect against Grimmsnarl + Gengar leads to scout Fake Out. Metagross is the preferred screen/Fairy answer via Psychic Fangs and Meteor Mash. Tsareena pressures Primarina and Avalugg and supplies Queenly Majesty support. Rain mode remains an alternative in later games if Primarina is absent or manageable.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out Whims to deny Prankster Tailwind/Encore/LS. Mega Gengar Shadow Ball Delphox (2x) for Shadow Tag trap + pressure mega threat. Screens later; Cloud Nine back for rain.

decisions.rationale: Ape tanks Tsareena (HJK immune, TA weak, PW ~50-70%) and Delphox DG/HW (~30-48%); Ghost RF 2x Delphox. Alt dies to full TA and offers less immediate pressure. Screens next.

decisions.rationale: Switching Tsareena activates Queenly Majesty to block Grimmsnarl's Fake Out into either slot. Mega Delphox reaches 204 Speed, exceeding Mega Gengar's revealed maximum of 200, and threatens a guaranteed Psychic OHKO before Gengar can attack unless it Protects or receives Light Screen support.

Psychic from Mega Delphox guarantees an OHKO on unscreened Mega Gengar. Tsareena's Queenly Majesty prevents opposing priority moves targeting it or its allies, making it a strong pivot against Fake Out. Preserve Delphox for Gengar and Annihilape when practical. Metagross is the preferred screen/Fairy answer through Psychic Fangs and Meteor Mash. Tsareena pressures Primarina and Avalugg. Rain mode remains an alternative in later games if Primarina is absent or manageable.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Annihilape)
decisions.rationale: Ape dies to Psychic/PW; switch Altaria into LS (Prankster first). Altaria walls both (Psychic/DG/HW/PW all weak or middling under screen). Preserves Ape; Cloud Nine online vs rain.

Delphox is guaranteed faster and Psychic removes Annihilape before it can use Rage Fist. Tsareena simultaneously pressures Grimmsnarl with the more accurate Wide Lens-boosted High Jump Kick; Fighting is neutral into Dark/Fairy.

Opponent game-one lead was Gengar/Grimmsnarl with Annihilape replacing Gengar. Rain remains an alternative in later games if Primarina is absent or manageable.

decisions.rationale: Prankster Reflect first halves Tsareena physicals (TA/HJK). WoW burns Tsareena to cut Atk. LS already covers Delphox specials. Keeps Cloud Nine up vs rain.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Dazzling Gleam moves first, pressures both foes through Light Screen, and deals stronger damage to Altaria than Psychic after spread modifiers. Triple Axel then exploits Altaria’s 4× Ice weakness; Wide Lens makes each accuracy check 99%. This also avoids wasting Tsareena into a likely Prankster Reflect on Grimmsnarl.

Tsareena’s Queenly Majesty protects its side from opposing targeted priority; Wide Lens makes its 90%-accurate moves 99% accurate per check. Preserve Delphox for Gengar and Annihilape when practical. Metagross is the preferred screen/Fairy answer via Psychic Fangs and Meteor Mash. Tsareena pressures Primarina and Avalugg. Opponent’s game-one four are Gengar, Grimmsnarl, Annihilape, and Altaria. Their lead was Gengar/Grimmsnarl; Grimmsnarl carries Light Clay dual screens, and Altaria has Cloud Nine plus Tailwind, Roost, Will-O-Wisp, and Moonblast. Rain remains an alternative in later games if Primarina is absent or manageable.

decisions.rationale: Ape must Protect: Delphox Psychic still OHKOes through LS (~2/3) and Tsareena PW can OHKO through Reflect. Grimm dies to most attacks from 27%; SB Delphox for -1 SpA/chip if they focus Ape Protect instead. Screens already up.

decisions.rationale: Dazzling Gleam pressures both foes and should finish the weakened Grimmsnarl based on its prior damage through Light Screen. Power Whip adds the strongest legal neutral hit into Annihilape without wasting Tsareena’s attack into the likely-falling Grimmsnarl.

decisions.rationale: Alone vs full HP Delphox+Tsareena. LS still lets Psychic OHKO (~111-152%); Reflect leaves Power Whip near-OHKO. Delphox outspeeds and KOs before Ape acts. Must Protect (1/3) for any series chance; attack loses on the spot. RF still BP50 (no hits landed).

decisions.rationale: Double-target Annihilape with Psychic and Power Whip. Psychic is the strongest accurate option through Light Screen; Power Whip adds the strongest reflected follow-up without powering Rage Fist multiple times. This maximizes the chance to finish the opponent’s last Pokémon despite a possible consecutive Protect.

reflections.summary: Lost because team-preview lead of Mega Gengar + Grimmsnarl into Whimsicott + Delphox was immediately punished: Tsareena switched in (Queenly Majesty blocked Fake Out) and Delphox Psychic OHKOed the Psychic-weak Gengar before screens or offense could establish, collapsing the game.
reflections.adjustment: Re-evaluate preview: do not bring/mega Gengar into Delphox (or lead it); select a different four/lead that pressures Delphox+Tsareena without a free KO and sets screens safely before committing Ape.
reflections.notebook: Opp: rain Politoed Drizzle+ShedShell; Basculegion SwiftSwim MysticWater Jolly WaveCrash/LastRespects/AquaJet/Protect; Mega Delphox Timid Psychic/HeatWave/DGleam/Protect (megas immediately); Metagross LO Adamant MeteorMash/PsychicFangs/IcePunch/Protect; Whimsicott MentalHerb Prankster Timid Tailwind/Encore/LS/Moonblast; Tsareena WideLens Queenly Adamant PowerWhip/TripleAxel/HJK/Protect. Leads Whims+Delphox, Tsareena switch-in punishes FO/priority. Our core: CloudNine Altaria; Mega Gengar ShadowTag (Psychic-frail—avoid leading/mega vs Delphox); Grimmsnarl LC screens+FO+SpiritBreak; Annihilape Defiant RF wincon. Priority: deny Tailwind/rain, respect Queenly (no FO into open Tsareena), stack screens before Ape, tag Delphox/Metagross only on safe entry.

reflections.summary: Won because the preview plan matched well: Mega Delphox outsped and immediately removed Mega Gengar, while Tsareena nullified Grimmsnarl’s Fake Out and provided complementary pressure. Delphox and Tsareena then overwhelmed the screen-based core without feeding Annihilape unnecessary Rage Fist boosts.
reflections.adjustment: If the opponent shows the same Gengar–Grimmsnarl core, keep these four and Mega Delphox, but lead Tsareena beside Delphox directly; preserve Metagross to remove screens with Psychic Fangs. Reconsider Whimsicott only if Primarina or Avalugg replaces part of the game-one core.
reflections.notebook: Mega Delphox outspeeds maximum-Speed Mega Gengar and unscreened Psychic guarantees the OHKO. Opponent favored Mega Gengar plus Grimmsnarl, followed by dual screens and defensive Annihilape Protects; Altaria supplied Cloud Nine and potential Tailwind. Tsareena’s Queenly Majesty blocks targeted priority for its side and its Wide Lens makes 90%-accurate attacks 99% accurate. Against the same composition, use Mega Delphox with Tsareena and retain Metagross for Psychic Fangs; attack Annihilape with strong single hits rather than multi-hit Triple Axel. Reassess Whimsicott’s slot if Primarina or Avalugg is brought.
